concerns.text: FR-006 and FR-011 still state the same requirement nearly verbatim (FR-011 only appends 'to explicitly validate the scaling law hypothesis'). Both read: "System MUST perform a linear regression of 'Empirical Sample Count' vs 'N' across multiple runs (≥ 30) and test if the slope matches the theoretical slope using a t-test on the regression coefficient at α = 0.05". Collapse into one FR or clearly differentiate them.

FR-008 ('MUST log the distance of the final policy from the theoretical Pareto frontier for each configuration') is subsumed by FR-017, which mandates the same calculation plus the scalarization method and documentation. Consider merging FR-008 into FR-017 or making FR-008 reference FR-017's method to avoid two FRs owning the same computation.
